title: Don’t Blame the Data, Blame the Model: Understanding Noise and Bias When Learning from Subjective Annotations
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of model confidence and label aggregation (Single-GT vs. Multi-GT) in subjective NLP tasks such as toxicity and hate speech detection. While the subject matter involves social bias, the study does not contain a component evaluating or benchmarking religion, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/ethical frameworks.
